FAQ
What is a Singtel SIM Only plan, and is it right for me?
A Singtel SIM Only plan is a no-contract mobile plan that gives you Singtel 5G+ access without bundling a new phone. It’s a good fit if you already have a device and want more flexibility, together with perks like free Caller ID, Asia roaming and eSIM support.
Do I need to sign a contract for a Singtel SIM Only plan?
No. Singtel SIM Only plans are no-contract plans, so you can stay flexible without signing up for a bundled phone contract. You can still enjoy upgraded 5G+ access and selected perks such as free Caller ID, Asia roaming and monthly cashback with PayLater.
Do I get 5G+ with a Singtel SIM Only plan?
Yes. Singtel SIM Only plans include upgraded 5G+ access. Depending on the plan you choose, you’ll get 5G+ Enhanced or 5G+ Priority, with higher tiers designed for a faster and more premium network experience.
What extras do I get with a SIM Only plan?
Your Singtel SIM Only plan can include free Caller ID, Asia roaming, monthly cashback with PayLater and eSIM support. Selected tiers also come with added security and entertainment benefits.
Can I use eSIM instead of a physical SIM?
Yes. Singtel SIM Only plans are available on eSIM on supported devices, so you can get connected without using a physical SIM card.
How do I choose the right SIM Only plan for me?
Choose based on three things: how much data you use, how often you travel, and which perks matter most to you. If you want a simpler everyday plan, a lower tier may be enough. If you use more data, travel more often or want extra benefits, a higher 5G+ tier is likely the better fit.
Is a Singtel SIM Only plan a good fit for me if I travel often?
Yes. Singtel SIM Only plans include Asia roaming, and selected higher-tier plans also add Malaysia or wider roaming support. If you travel often, it’s worth choosing a plan with the roaming benefits that match where you go most.
Do I get any security features with my Singtel SIM Only plan?
Yes. Eligible Singtel SIM Only plans come with McAfee Mobile Security to help you stay safer online. The exact level of protection depends on the plan tier, with higher tiers offering more coverage.
Can I still save on a new phone if I choose SIM Only?
Yes. With PayLater, eligible Singtel SIM Only plans can give you monthly cashback on a new phone purchase. That helps you save on a new device even if you choose not to take a traditional phone contract.
Why should I choose SIM Only instead of a phone plan?
Choose SIM Only if you already have a phone and want no-contract flexibility with a simpler monthly setup. Choose a phone plan instead if you want a new device bundled with your line at a reduced upfront price on contract.
